transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
Hello! I'm Dora, and I've just finished your post-cataract surgery follow-up check. 

Do you have any questions about your surgery or your recovery?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Hi! Yes, I do have a few questions. First, I'm wondering when I can start doing a little bit of gardening?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
Great question! You can start doing light gardening after 1 week following your surgery. However, you should avoid any strenuous or heavy exercise for about a month after your operation.

Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Got it, thank you! Another thing I'm curious about is when I can start using my eye gel for dry eyes?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
That's a good question. If you were using eye gel for dry eyes before your operation, it's safe to continue using it now, unless you've been told otherwise by your doctor.

However, if you need a new supply, your GP should be able to provide some more for you.

Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Thank you for clarifying that! I'm also finding myself very sensitive to bright light. Is that normal?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.intended:
Yes, some light sensitivity is quite normal as your eyes adjust to the new lenses. If it's mild and things just seem brighter than you're used to, we'd recommend wearing sunglasses when you're outside.

However, if you're experiencing significant pain in bright light or your eye is also red and painful, that's not normal and we may need to check it further. In that case, please contact your care team.

Do you have any other questions?
transcript.delivered: Yes, some light sensitivity is quite normal as your eyes adjust to the new lenses.

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: That makes sense, thanks for the advice. I have one more question: should I still have some blurriness by now?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
It's common for vision to not be completely clear in the first week after surgery, and it should improve quickly and settle down over time.

How long has it been since your operation? If your vision is still quite blurry or getting significantly worse, we may need to check it to make sure everything's okay.

Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: It's been a couple of weeks now. I'll keep an eye on it and get in touch if there's no improvement. Thank you for answering all my questions so clearly. I don't have any more questions at the moment.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: That sounds like a good plan. Just to confirm - have all your questions about your cataract surgery recovery been answered today?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, they've all been answered. Thanks for your help!

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: You're very welcome! Take care, and best of luck with your recovery.
